source_text: Qui per Moysen accipiunt portionem omnes primogeniti sunt: Ruben ex Lia, Gad ex Zelfa, Manasses ex Aseneth. Non fortuitu — duorum populorum forma adumbratur: unius primogeniti per naturam, alterius per fidem et gratiam. Nec illis qui per legem placuerunt requies datur nisi adiuvent fratres in proeliis. Mulieres et infantes quietem accipiunt; viri fortes exeunt in auxilium. Vide hodie laboranti in agone: Isaias sermonibus illuminat, Hieremias iaculis hostes cordis effugat, Daniel de regno Christi et Antichristi praemonet, Ezechiel sacramenta coelestia signat, Osee et prophetarum agmen praecincti lumbos in veritate pugnant nobiscum. Infans non loquitur — quid iuvat qui nihil locutus est? Mulier infirmum vas ad conflictum non venit. Qui veniunt ex terra Moysi dicunt: Sicut audivimus Moysen, ita audiemus et te — omnis qui audit Moysen audiat et Iesum; de Iesu enim ille scripsit.
pass_a_gloss: Who through Moses receive portion all firstborn are: Reuben from Leah, Gad from Zilpah, Manasseh from Asenath. Not by-chance — of-two peoples form is-sketched: of-one firstborn through nature, of-other through faith and grace. Nor to-those who through law pleased rest is-given unless they-help brothers in battles. Women and infants rest receive; men strong go-out unto help. See today to-one-laboring in contest: Isaiah by-sermons illuminates, Jeremiah by-darts enemies of-heart drives-off, Daniel concerning kingdom of-Christ and Antichrist forewarns, Ezekiel sacraments heavenly marks, Hosea and of-prophets troop girded loins in truth fight with-us. Infant not speaks — what helps who nothing has-spoken? Woman weak vessel unto conflict not comes. Who come from land of-Moses say: As we-heard Moses, so we-will-hear also you — every who hears Moses let-him-hear also Jesus; concerning Jesus for he wrote.
pass_b_english: All who receive a share through Moses are firstborn: Reuben from Leah, Gad from Zilpah, Manasseh from Asenath. Not by chance — two peoples are foreshadowed: one firstborn by nature, the other receiving inheritance by faith and grace. Those justified under the law are not given rest until they help their brothers in battle. Women and little ones receive quiet; the strong men go out to help. See how they aid me today in life’s contest: Isaiah lights me with his reading; Jeremiah comes girded and drives off the heart’s dark foes with the darts of his scroll; Daniel warns of Christ’s kingdom and Antichrist’s fraud; Ezekiel signs heavenly mysteries in the wheels; Hosea leads the twelve, all [[girding their loins with truth >> Bible:Ephesians 6:14]] to help their brothers. An infant — one who does not speak — cannot help me; a woman the Apostle calls a [[weaker vessel >> Bible:1 Peter 3:7]] does not come to the clash. Those who come from Moses’ land say: [[As we heard Moses, so will we hear you >> Bible:Joshua 1:17]] — whoever hears Moses must hear Jesus also, for [[Moses wrote of him >> Bible:John 5:46]].
